selection.title: How Package Selection Works
selection.description: The right setup depends on the business, not a generic checklist. Here’s the basic path.

review.title: 1. Review the space
review.text: We look at the business layout, device needs, Wi-Fi expectations, current pain points, and how the team actually works.

choose.title: 2. Choose the right tier
choose.text: Starter, Growth, and Complete are starting points. The final recommendation depends on coverage, reliability, control, and budget.

build.title: 3. Build a clean path forward
build.text: The goal is not to oversell hardware. The goal is to build a setup that is practical, reliable, manageable, and easier to grow over time.

brandsSection.title: Why These Solutions?
brandsSection.description: Ozony Tech doesn’t recommend equipment based on hype. The right setup depends on your space, budget, business type, and how much control or scalability you need.

unifi.description: A strong option when a business wants clean management, strong visibility, and a more unified network experience.

omada.description: A great value-focused choice for businesses that want solid performance and cleaner management without overspending.

aruba.description: A premium small-business option for businesses that want polished networking, simpler management, and a strong long-term setup path.

fit.title: Great Fit For
fit.description: These packages are designed around the kinds of businesses that benefit most from clean, reliable networking and practical IT support.

faq.title: Packages FAQ
faq.description: A few common questions about how the package tiers work.

rightPackage.question: Which package is right for my business?
rightPackage.answer: That depends on your space, number of users and devices, Wi-Fi expectations, current setup, and whether you need a cleaner upgrade path for future growth.

customized.question: Can packages be customized?
customized.answer: Yes. These packages are designed as starting points, not rigid boxes. The final recommendation can be adjusted around your business needs, layout, budget, and goals.

brands.question: Do you only work with one brand?
brands.answer: No. Ozony Tech chooses solutions based on reliability, budget, ease of management, and how well the setup fits the business environment.

upgradeLater.question: Can I start with a smaller setup and upgrade later?
upgradeLater.answer: Yes. A good setup should make it easier to grow over time instead of forcing a full rebuild later.

itSupport.question: Do these packages include IT support?
itSupport.answer: Packages can include setup support and practical guidance. Businesses that need recurring help can also review managed IT services or request a custom support plan.

aiLead.question: Do you offer AI lead response setup too?
aiLead.answer: Yes. Ozony Tech also offers an AI Lead Response Agent service for businesses that want faster lead follow-up, alerts, confirmation emails, and AI-assisted response drafts.

finalCta.title: Ready to find the right setup for your business?
finalCta.description: Whether you need a smaller starter setup, a more complete long-term solution, or a custom mix of IT support, networking, Wi-Fi, firewall setup, and automation, Ozony Tech can help you choose a practical path forward.
